claim: Etsy charges a listing fee of $0.20 USD for each item listed for sale on Etsy.com or its mobile apps.
evidence: You will be charged a listing fee of $0.20 USD for each item that you list for sale on Etsy.com or Etsy's mobile apps.

claim: Etsy.com listings expire after four months.
evidence: Etsy.com listings expire after four months.

claim: For a listing with multiple quantities, the listing is automatically renewed at $0.20 after each item sells.
evidence: the listing will be automatically renewed at $0.20 after each of the items sells.

claim: Etsy charges a transaction fee of 6.5% of the price you display for each listing.
evidence: a transaction fee of 6.5% of the price you display for each listing

claim: The transaction fee also applies to the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping.
evidence: the amount you charge for shipping and gift wrapping

claim: If you sell from the US, the transaction fee does not apply to sales tax.
evidence: If you sell from the US, the transaction fee will not apply to sales tax.

claim: Etsy's payment processing fee for a seller whose bank account is in the United States is 3% + 0.25 USD.
evidence: United States | 3% + 0.25 USD

claim: Etsy's payment processing fee is assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax if applicable.
evidence: The fee amount will be assessed on the gross order amount, including shipping and tax (if applicable).

claim: The standard Offsite Ads fee is 15% on Attributed Orders unless the 12% fee applies.
evidence: The standard fee you will pay is 15% on Attributed Orders, unless the 12% fee applies as described below.

claim: Once a shop has made $10,000 USD or more in sales over the prior 365 days, it pays a 12% Offsite Ads fee on Attributed Orders.
evidence: If at any time your shop has made sales of $10,000 USD or more over the prior 365 days

claim: A shop under $10,000 USD in sales over the prior 365 days can opt out of Offsite Ads while it stays under that threshold.
evidence: unless you opt out of participation in Offsite Ads for the duration your shop is under the $10,000 USD threshold.

claim: Once a shop reaches the $10,000 USD threshold, a prior opt-out no longer applies.
evidence: The prior opt out while under the $10,000 USD threshold will no longer apply

claim: The total Offsite Ads fee on a single Attributed Order will not exceed $100 USD.
evidence: the total Offsite Ads fee you'll pay on a single Attributed Order will not exceed $100 USD.

claim: An Attributed Order is an order placed within 30 days of a buyer clicking an Offsite Ad.
evidence: a buyer clicks on it, and then places any orders from your shop within 30 days of that click

claim: Offsite Ads fees are a percentage of the total order amount: the displayed listing price plus shipping and gift wrapping and, in some jurisdictions, taxes.
